name: Norms: four selection rules (Galán & Izquierdo Fig. 12)
description: Galán & Izquierdo's Fig. 12: the metanorms game under Axelrod's selection and their three alternatives; the metric is the share of runs collapsed. Measured (release, seeds 1–10, recorded 2026-09-26): after 10 000 generations 0, 0.8, 0.9 and 0.9 under Axelrod's rule, a random tournament, a roulette wheel and above-the-mean selection (after 1 000: 0, 0.6, 0.2, 0.1). Axelrod's rule is the one that keeps the norm; any of the other three, equally reasonable, loses it.
